title: Change Proposal Schema
description: Governance interface. A proposed change to one governed Metamodel record, with the evidence for it. Proposals are submitted by an agent, a person or a system; the governing service validates them against the Metamodel, matches them to existing records, arbitrates conflicts, scores confidence, and assigns a treatment under the published autonomy policy. Fields set by the governing service (treatment, matchedEntityID, review) are ignored on submission.

changeProposalID.description: Unique identifier for the proposal, assigned by the submitter, e.g. CP-2026-10-27-0001

changeType.description: Kind of change proposed. Decides the autonomy rule that applies

target.description: The record the proposal creates or changes

record.description: For create and update changes: the full proposed record, valid against the schema for target.domainType. For other changes: omitted, or only the fields that change

changedFields.description: Top-level fields of the record that the proposal changes, for update changes

baseVersion.description: Version of the governed record the proposal was made against. The governing service rejects the proposal as stale if the record has moved on

supersededByEntityID.description: For supersede changes: the record that replaces the target

evidence.description: Sources relied on for the change

rationale.description: Why the change is proposed, in source-describing language

triggerID.description: Trigger record for the instrument change that prompted the proposal

treatment.description: Set by the governing service: how the proposal is handled under the autonomy policy

matchedEntityID.description: Set by the governing service: an existing record the proposal was matched to, so one instrument is never entered twice

review.description: Set by the governing service: the review of a queued or escalated proposal

changeType.description: create = a new record; update = change to fields other than status, dates or tier; statusChange, dateChange, tierChange = change to those fields; supersede = replace a record with another, keeping the old version; remove = withdraw a record from publication, keeping it in history; reverify = confirm a record against its source with no other change; addLead = record a lead (commentary or news) to an official source; addCommentaryLink = attach a commentary link to a record

treatment.description: publishedUnverified = published automatically and marked unverified; published = published automatically (reverification only); reviewQueue = waits for a named approver; escalated = an unresolved conflict sent to the method owner; convertedToLead = the evidence cannot set a status or date alone, so the proposal is kept as a lead; rejected = invalid, stale or duplicate

sourceEvidence.description: One source relied on for a change

title.description: Title of the source document or page

sourceRank.description: Source precedence: 1 official text (legislation register, gazette, the instrument itself); 2 regulator publication; 3 standards body publication; 4 law firm or industry body commentary; 5 news

externalOrgID.description: External Organization that published the source

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the retrieved content, hex encoded, so the same content can be recognised later

excerpt.description: The passage relied on, quoted from the source

dataFlowID.description: Data flow (monitored source) the evidence came through

reviewState.description: Review of a proposal by a named person

approverName.description: Name of the person who decided

record.title: Material service providers
record.statement: CPS 230 provides that an APRA-regulated entity must maintain a register of its material service providers.
